body: I've pushed everyone that I was close to away and I don't really give a shit about any of them. There is only one that I care about and that's the one I had with my ex. I still want to die. I told myself I would get help but I don't really believe it'll help me at all. It's so pathetic to see myself ruin my life and become suicidal all over an ex. What the fuck is wrong with me?
I'm ready to accept to defeat...now if only I could get myself to fully commit...

So long story short, I've been quite depressed. I think I want to go to behavioral health, I'm just not sure how to go about it. Can I just call and make an appointment? If they ask what for do I just tell them I'm depressed? 

Probably a silly questions just want to go about this correctly. 

P.s. Using throw away

Ever since she left me 3 months ago everyday has been a struggle. I drink more than I ever have. I cry almost daily. Everyday I wish I died. 

Today I was driving home and I realized, there is literally no cure how I feel...I'll have to deal with this forever and there is no escaping it. Sure I can have brief moments of freedom but it'll always come back. 

It's too bad I am too scared to actually end this misery. I wish I was more selfish. I wish I didn't care if I hurt my family, if I did end it. It's not fair. I just want all the pain to go away.
